content.title: 过去分词作状语 速查
content.intro: 过去分词(done)放在句首或句中作状语,可表时间、原因、条件、让步。判断口诀:看分词的逻辑主语——它一定是主句主语;主语承受动作(被动/完成)用过去分词 done,主语发出动作(主动/进行)用现在分词 doing。

rows: Moved by his words, she accepted his gift.(= Because she was moved…)
Given more time, we could finish.(= If we were given more time…)
Though invited, he didn't come.(= Though he was invited…)
Used for shows, the hall is full of energy.(被动)≠ Using…(主动)

specialRules.rule: 过去分词的逻辑主语 = 主句主语,且二者是被动/完成关系
specialRules.mark: Painted in dark colours, the room needed lights.(room 被刷漆)

specialRules.rule: 主语发出动作(主动)→ 必须改用现在分词 doing
specialRules.mark: Recording at home, the members joined the videos.(members 主动录)

specialRules.rule: 表条件常用 Given …;表让步常保留 though/although + done
be born / be filled with / be interested in 等被动短语,作状语只留分词
specialRules.mark: Born in 1970, he… / Filled with spirit, they…

why: 状语从句与主句主语相同、且从句是被动语态时,可省去从句主语和 be 动词,只留过去分词;过去分词本身就带'被动/完成'之意,所以无须再写 was/were。
gaokaoPoints: done 还是 doing:抓住'主句主语是动作的承受者还是发出者'——承受者用 done,发出者用 doing。语法填空、读后续写高频。
Given / Moved / Born / Faced with 等开头的状语结构是写作高分句式;条件用 Given,让步用 Though + done。

examVsReal.exam: Moved by the song, she cried.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: The song moved her so much that she cried.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考分词状语的紧凑句式;口语里更常用 so … that 或直接两句话。

examVsReal.exam: Given more time, we could finish.(考试)
examVsReal.real: If we had more time, we could finish.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 Given 体现凝练;日常表达常还原成 if 从句,更口语化。
